name: Sekai-Ichi Yaritai Jugyou ~Rin-sensei no Loli Bitch na Hanten Sekai~
original_name: 世界一ヤリたい授業 ～林先生のロリビッチな反転世界～
source:
Shuuji Hayashi was a rookie teacher that all the students hated.
One day three of them locked him in the equipment room.

That's where he found the glasses.

They didn't just give him a new view of the world.
When Shuuji wore the glasses, the world changed before his eyes. 

[From: [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173376.html] DLsite English[/url]]
